name: Be Fit Gym
address: Carrefour Express Bldg - opp. NMC Medical Centre and Madina Supermarket - Hay Al Nahda - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: FROM FAT TO FIT! The utmost place for all your fitness needs. We are here to support and guide you. We have the simplest solutions for your health concerns even weight loss or weight gain...

reviews.author: Shabari Girish
reviews.text:
Be Fit Gym has a great atmosphere with excellent equipment and a very motivating environment.
Trainer Ashique is highly supportive, knowledgeable, and always pushes you to give your best.
His workout guidance and attention to proper form really helped improve my fitness journey.
The gym is clean, well-maintained, and perfect for both beginners and experienced members.
Highly recommended for anyone looking to achieve their fitness goals with the right trainer!

reviews.author: Delson Thomas
reviews.text:
I can confidently say that joining Ashique training program has been one of the best decisions of my life. He not only pushes me beyond my limits but also guides me with the right form, diet tips, and motivation every single day. In just a short time, I’ve seen amazing changes in my strength, energy, and overall confidence.

What sets him apart is his personal attention — he treats every client’s goal as his own and makes sure we stay consistent. His positive attitude and discipline truly inspire me to keep going, no matter what.

If you’re serious about fitness and want results that actually last, I 100% recommend training with ASHIQUE The best place

reviews.text: Be Fit Gym has been one of the best gyms in Al Nahda Sharjah. I've been a member since 4 years now. The trainers are really knowledgable and friendly as well. I would recommend this gym to anyone whose looking to join. Cheers !

reviews.text:
BE FIT  GYM is one of best gym I have visited. One of the best experiences with all the trainer especially with coach Mr.Akhil. Our trainer Akhil is very professional, polite, energetic and helpful. He is well trained coach who is knowledgeable about how to achieve our goal and trained dietitian. The different types of workout that he gives never get bored. Which why I highly recommend people to go this coach. From first day to till now I am getting training with him to achieve the goals.

About the gym, it has a lot of positive vibes and environmental friendly which why I recommend all my friends and family member to join this gym

reviews.author: Ummer Mukthar
reviews.text: I recently joined Be Fit Gym and have been extremely pleased with my experience so far. The facility is clean and well-maintained, with a wide variety of equipment and a good mix of cardio and weightlifting options. The staff is friendly and helpful, always willing to offer advice or assist with any questions I have. The atmosphere is positive and encouraging, and I've already made some great connections with other members. Overall, I highly recommend Be fit Gym to anyone looking for a high-quality fitness center.

reviews.author: dani george
reviews.text: Be Fit Gym is a fantastic fitness facility with top-notch facilities and equipment. The staff is friendly and welcoming, creating a positive and motivating environment. Mr. Akhil, the trainer, is exceptional in his knowledge, expertise, and dedication to helping clients reach their fitness goals. I highly recommend Be Fit Gym for anyone seeking a great workout experience …..
